adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` now checks `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. In JavaScript, `String#replace` without a global regex replaces only the first underscore, so a model type containing multiple underscores (e.g. `foo_bar_baz`) would become `foo-bar_baz` and fail to match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry like `foo-bar-baz`, causing it to use `/` instead of `/admin/`. The diff doesn’t show any such multi-underscore admin model types being used, so the impact is an edge-case robustness issue rather than a demonstrated breakage in this PR.
